environment.description: Same Go service deployed on EC2 in private subnet. CloudFront distribution (d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net) configured with WebSocket protocol support via cache behavior with Origin Request Policy that forwards Upgrade/Connection headers. Origin is ALB (internal) on port 8080. CloudFront distribution uses Trusted Key Group (kg-0x7f3a9b2c) for signed URLs with RSA-2048 key pair; viewer access restricted via signed URLs with 60-second expiry and IP-restricted custom policy (source IP embedded in policy condition). The EC2 security group (sg-0def456) allows inbound ONLY from the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16) — no public inbound. ALB security group allows inbound only from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). Route53 CNAME points to CloudFront. The signed URL policy uses custom JSON policy with DateLessThan (Unix epoch + 60s from generation) AND IpAddress condition restricting to the requesting client's /32. Key rotation occurs every 24h via Lambda rotating the trusted key group.

config.cache_behavior: WebSocket support enabled, Origin Request Policy forwarding Upgrade+Connection+Sec-WebSocket-*
config.trusted_key_group: kg-0x7f3a9b2c, RSA-2048, custom policy signed URLs
config.signed_url_policy: custom policy with DateLessThan (now+60s) AND IpAddress/32 condition
config.origin: internal ALB, port 8080, HTTPS to origin
config.subnet: private, no IGW, NAT for egress only
config.key_rotation: Lambda rotates key pair in trusted key group every 24h
